name: Deiter
source:
Brigadier General and Base Ranking Officer, Prometheus. He devises battle plans to use against the Meteoras and gives orders to Makhia pilots on the field. He was promoted from operator to General when Julie saw his talents. Few, however, know of his past.

Superior officer to Chloe, Yamato, and Aoba, his stern, cold demeanor commands their respect.
